name: codex-skill-gate
description: Binary coding/non-coding gate that keeps Codex skill metadata out of non-coding sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Zero skill metadata until a coding session is detected
interface.longDescription: Codex Skill Gate disables the built-in skill catalog by default, classifies each session as coding or non-coding, and re-injects a compact skill catalog only when the session is coding.
interface.defaultPrompt: Install Codex Skill Gate and show me how to verify it.
